context:
Decision gate: owner confirms no older client on any machine still needs the store. One-way: older clients refuse the store afterwards.

Review 2026-11-13: set to blocked on the owner's confirmation that no older client on any machine needs the store. Verification rubric before the call: `ps -axo pid,lstart,command | grep tractable-mcp`, then for each process whose working directory or --state-remote is this repository, show it was started after the installed tractable was last changed (or is stopped); `list_items` shows no live claim held by another worker. After the call: `tractable validate` passes and `show_batch` on a throwaway registration, then `abort_batch`, leaves no active batch. Guardrails: never stop another session's process; the agent does not confirm the cutover on a timeout or a default answer; one-way, so no retry with different arguments after a partial failure without reading references/recovery.md.

Owner decision 2026-11-14: migrate now. Both tractable-mcp processes bound to this store were started 2026-11-14 08:47, after tractable 1.1.1 was installed on 2026-11-12 07:55. Merge targets (owner, 2026-11-14): site code, workflows and corrections to released documentation go to main on green ci, then main is merged into next; only documentation of unreleased behaviour waits on next.

description: Problem: the todo-state store is below schema 4, so `register_batch` is refused until a one-way cutover is confirmed, and the cutover requires every process with access to the store to be stopped or upgraded. On 2026-11-12 another session's tractable-mcp (started before that day's reinstall of tractable 1.1.1) was bound to this store, so the cutover could not be confirmed and the release-pin work ran as a serial batch. Outcome: the store is at schema 4 and a prepared batch can be registered.
